title: CAWM-Mamba: A unified model for infrared-visible image fusion and compound adverse weather restoration

contributions.improvement: Robust fusion in complex environments by handling multiple degradations simultaneously
contributions.implementation_detail: Proposing CAWM-Mamba, an innovative end-to-end framework for image fusion and restoration under compound weather conditions
contributions.improve_from: Previous approaches limited to single-weather restoration

contributions.improvement: Enhanced fusion process, improved visible light feature quality, and effective alignment of features from infrared and visible images
contributions.implementation_detail: Introducing Weather-Aware Preprocess Module (WAPM) and Cross-Modal Feature Interaction Module (CFIM) for embedding global weather information, improving visible light feature quality, and multi-scale pooling and feature interaction
contributions.improve_from: Existing methods lacking weather-aware preprocessing and explicit cross-modal interaction

contributions.improvement: Improved model's ability to handle complex degradation and enhanced generalization across various weather conditions
contributions.implementation_detail: Developing Wavelet Space State Block (WSSB) for decoupling multi-frequency degradation patterns using wavelet-domain decomposition, including Freq-SSM for anisotropic high-frequency details and Common Degradation Space Mechanism (CDSM) for unified degradation representation
contributions.improve_from: Existing methods that struggle with complex degradation patterns and generalization

datasets.details: Contains 100,000 real and synthetic image pairs. For single-degradation, 700 images for each weather type (rain, haze, snow) for training, 50 separate images for testing. For compound-degradation, 1000 images for each type (rain&haze, rain&snow, haze&snow) for training, 50 separate images for testing. Test scenes are completely distinct from training scenes.

experiment_setup.training_details: Trained using two Nvidia GeForce RTX 3090 GPUs. Image cropping size gradually expands from 64 to 144. Adam optimizer with default parameters and an initial learning rate of 0.0001. WSSBs adopt a U-Net architecture with block configuration [8,10,10,12,10,10,8]. Feature channels in WSSBs gradually increase from 48 to 384 and then decrease to 48.
